content.title: Chapter 42 - FIRE PREVENTION AND PROTECTION — Sec. 42-55. - I.F.C. Section 503.2, Specifications.
content.summary:
Section 503.2. Specifications
, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"503.2 Specifications.
Fire apparatus access roads shall be installed and arranged in accordance with Sections
                  503.2.1 through 503.2.8 and Appendix B."
(Ord. No.
4739
, § 3, 9-14-2020)
